scientific_integrity: The global parameter theorem is proved by a saturated lattice and semigroup argument; finite scripts corroborate examples only. No independent validation or priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Classifies the normal-fan projective toric variety and its reduced singular set, not singular schemes, birational resolutions, or cohomological invariants. The unit-cap specialization was already available; broader abstract GIT results may imply portions. Possible unindexed or differently phrased prior classification remains a residual risk.
title: Singular baskets of integer box-section toric varieties
